title: generate/kube API endpoint sends Content-Type: application/x-tar instead of text/vnd.yaml
body:
### Issue Description

The `GET /libpod/generate/kube` endpoint (used by `podman generate kube` / `podman kube
generate`, and callable directly via the libpod HTTP API) returns Kubernetes YAML but
labels it with the wrong `Content-Type`: `application/x-tar` instead of `text/vnd.yaml`.

This contradicts the endpoint's own swagger docs in pkg/api/server/register_kube.go:

    // produces:
    // - text/vnd.yaml
    // - application/json

Root cause: the handler (pkg/api/handlers/libpod/generate.go) sends the YAML through the
shared utils.WriteResponse() helper, whose io.Reader branch hardcodes
`application/x-tar` it was built for the tar-streaming endpoints (image save/export,
`podman cp`) that are its other callers, and GenerateKube just reuses that path.

There's already a FIXME in generate.go calling this out, unresolved:

    // FIXME: Content-Type is being set as application/x-tar NOT text/vnd.yaml

Any client that trusts the documented Content-Type to parse the response (e.g. an SDK
generated from the swagger spec) will treat plain YAML text as a tar archive.

I've root-caused this and have a small patch ready  a WriteResponseWithContentType
helper alongside WriteResponse, so the other tar-streaming callers are untouched. 

### Steps to reproduce the issue

1. Start the podman API service:
   podman system service --time=0 unix:///tmp/podman.sock &
2. Create any container, e.g.:
   podman run -d --name test-gen alpine sleep 300
3. Query the generate/kube endpoint directly and inspect the response headers:
   curl -i --unix-socket /tmp/podman.sock "http://d/v5.0.0/libpod/generate/kube?names=test-gen"

### Describe the results you received

HTTP response headers include:
  Content-Type: application/x-tar

...while the response body is plain Kubernetes YAML text not
a tar archive.

### Describe the results you expected

Content-Type: text/vnd.yaml (or another appropriate text/YAML media type), matching the
"produces: text/vnd.yaml" declared in this endpoint's own swagger documentation in
pkg/api/server/register_kube.go.

### podman info output

```yaml
main branch,
version 6.2.0-dev, commit 7a6c0a0 (2026-08-28)

Podman version: 6.2.0-dev (main branch, commit 7a6c0a0, 2026-08-28)

unable to run verified this via source code
```

### Podman in a container

No

### Privileged Or Rootless

None

### Upstream Latest Release

Yes
